meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Nightride FM: turns off the CRT flicker overlays, blurs or hides now-playing text and chat, can hide visualizer, video and archive tabs
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome on https://nightride.fm/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA. Both received the same single-page markup (ids like `#pageEQ`, `#pageChat`), so one structure serves both fixtures.

- **CRT overlays**: five `.overlay` divs (`flicker`, `scanlines`, `scanline`, `noise`, `radial`) matched 5 (LIVE).
- **Now playing**: `#npArtist` and `#npTitle` 2 and `a.station h4` 8 station lines (LIVE).
- **Chat**: `#navChat` and `#pageChat` 2, with `pre.Msg` messages and `h4` name rows inside (LIVE; the chat showed real nicknames, which are not kept in the fixtures).
- **Visualizer** `canvas#waves` and `canvas#bars` 2; **video** `#navVideo` and `#pageVideo` 2; **archive** `#navArchive` and `#pageArchive` 2 (LIVE).

Not verified: the Settings page, other stations' sub-pages (the app keeps one document), the player controls while a stream plays (never hidden). The chat and video panes are separate "pages" toggled by script, so hiding them also removes the matching menu entries only because both are listed.
